core_principles: Dark Mode Depth: Use layers, not just black.
Contextual Density: High density for data, low density for reading.
Hidden Complexity: Tuck advanced tools (like AI Chat) into Drawers on mobile.

mobile_tabs.container: bg-[#18181b] p-1 rounded-xl flex w-full mb-4
mobile_tabs.trigger: flex-1 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-all data-[state=active]:bg-[#27272a] data-[state=active]:text-white data-[state=inactive]:text-[#8b949e]
mobile_tabs.note: Convert the large desktop cards into a simple 2-toggle switch on mobile to save vertical space.

card_list.card_mobile: p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#18181b] border border-[#27272a] active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform
card_list.action_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-[#09090b]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#27272a] z-40 flex gap-3

chat_interface.trigger: Fixed Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom-right

mobile_tabs.instruction: Use a conditional render: specific simpler UI for mobile (window.innerWidth < 768) or CSS hidden classes (hidden md:flex).

chat_drawer.instruction: Create a new component using Shadcn Drawer to house the Test Chat logic on mobile.

fab.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-[#FF6B35] shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 flex items-center justify-center z-50 active:scale-90 transition-transform

universal_guidelines: Touch Targets: All clickable elements must be at least 44px height on mobile.
Safe Areas: Add padding-bottom-safe to scroll views to avoid collision with iPhone home indicator.
Input Handling: On mobile, ensure inputs don't zoom the page (font-size >= 16px).
Loading States: Use skeletons instead of spinners for content loading to reduce layout shift.

HandoffAnalysis.jsx: Refactor the 'TabsList' to be responsive. On desktop, keep the big cards. On mobile (hidden md:flex vs flex md:hidden), show a compact segment switcher.
Ensure the 'ConversationCard' expands smoothly on mobile without jerking the scroll position.
AILearningTab.jsx: Hide the right column (Test Chat) on mobile breakpoints (hidden xl:block).
Add a 'Test AI' Floating Action Button (FAB) visible ONLY on mobile/tablet.
Implement a Shadcn 'Drawer' component that opens when the FAB is clicked.
Move the Chat Logic into a reusable component 'ChatInterface' so it can be rendered in both the Desktop Column and the Mobile Drawer without duplicating code.
Optimize the 'Venue Header' to be more compact on mobile.
